packageRules.description: React Native and its @react-native packages release in lockstep, and a mixed tree fails npm ci. Each React Native minor raises its react peer floor, so react moves with them.
Each Expo SDK release pins its own package versions, so the Expo fixture updates as one PR, majors included.
The Expo SDK pins react and react-native, so the Expo fixture takes them only with an Expo update.
ios/Package.swift declares only a minimum for opentelemetry-swift-core; hosts resolve its version through EDOT iOS.
